map.容器化第一步是写 Dockerfile。填入基础镜像、工作目录、暴露端口与启动命: Containerising a project starts with a Dockerfile. Fill in the base image, working directory, exposed port and start command, and this tool assembles a standard Dockerfile you can copy into the project root.
map.按所选技术栈生成 Dockerfile 骨架与最佳实践配置。: Generates a Dockerfile skeleton with best-practice settings for the chosen stack.
map.：FROM 指定基础镜像、RUN 执行命令、COPY/ADD 复制文件、WORK: : FROM sets the base image, RUN executes commands, COPY/ADD bring in files, WORKDIR sets the working directory, ENV sets environment variables, EXPOSE declares ports, and CMD/ENTRYPOINT define the start command.
map.：每条指令生成一层；合并 RUN 可减少层数，把变动少的步骤前置以复用构建缓存。: : every instruction creates a layer; merging RUN commands reduces the count, and putting rarely changing steps first lets the build cache be reused.
map.：用多阶段构建（multi-stage）只把产物拷入最终镜像，并用 .docke: : use a multi-stage build to copy only the artefacts into the final image, and exclude irrelevant files with .dockerignore.
map.：建议使用非 root 用户运行，固定基础镜像版本标签而非 latest。: : run as a non-root user and pin the base image to a version tag rather than latest.
map.示例为单阶段构建；生产建议用多阶段构建（builder 阶段编译、runtime: The example is a single-stage build; for production prefer a multi-stage build (compile in a builder stage, copy only the artefacts into the runtime stage) to keep the image small.
map.EXPOSE 仅声明文档化端口，真正映射由 docker run -p 决定；二: EXPOSE only documents the port; the actual mapping is decided by docker run -p, and the two should agree.
map.COPY . /app 前应放 .dockerignore 排除 node_mo: Put a .dockerignore in place before COPY . /app to exclude node_modules and the like, otherwise the build context grows and the cache is invalidated.
map.按语言生成基础 Dockerfile。: Generate a baseline Dockerfile for your language.
map.给新项目初始化镜像：按语言生成带依赖缓存层的基础 Dockerfile，再按实际: Initialise an image for a new project: generate a baseline Dockerfile with a dependency-cache layer for your language, then add or remove as needed — less work than starting from an empty file.
map.Node 项目 → `FROM node:20\nWORKDIR /app\nC:
Node project → `FROM node:20
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm i
CMD npm start`.
map.可生成 builder + runtime 两阶段瘦身。: It can generate a two-stage builder + runtime layout to slim the image.
map.为什么镜像这么大？: Why is the image so large?
map.常见原因有三：基础镜像选了完整版（如 ubuntu 而非 alpine/slim: There are usually three causes: a full-fat base image (ubuntu instead of alpine or slim), build dependencies left behind (apt caches, source packages), and build artefacts sharing a layer with the runtime. Use a multi-stage build so only the files needed at runtime reach the final image, and put apt-get clean together with the removal list in a single RUN instruction.
